entries.title: Dyson Sphere Program
entries.definitive_edition: Dyson Sphere Program on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Steam Early Access current Windows build
primary.why: Dyson Sphere Program is sourced as a Windows Early Access game; the native PC build is the only documented platform route and receives the current content updates.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Dyson Sphere Program on Steam or the Microsoft Store/Game Pass PC route for Windows PC and keep it updated to the latest Early Access build.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is still an Early Access/current-development PC release, so content and balance may change before a final 1.0 release.
